rationale: With Justice Sotomayor assigning in a 5-4, the majority opinion is most likely to be written either by her or by a textualist-harmonization author (Barrett or Kagan) to hold that § 3327(d)(2)(A) is an election/conversion rule that coexists with § 3695(a)'s 48-month aggregate cap. The dissent is likely to emphasize RadLAX-specific-controls-general and the view that § 3695(a) is only an outer ceiling, with a meaningful chance of a separate Gorsuch concurrence stressing anti-forfeiture and limited use of the veterans' canon post-Arellano.
